response.content: {"critique": "I checked the 'Who is affected' claims against the cited insights: the brief says 'One account reports the problem is causing formal complaints [i:79b4ab60815d6467]' and 'Another account states the issue is damaging client trust [i:9168ce0c6231bbca]', but both citations belong to the same account, Tarnholt Drive Cover, so 'another account' misrepresents the evidence. I also verified the quotes in 'Why now' and the manual-editing claim, which match the cited insights verbatim, and the figures (19 mentions, route distribution 8/8/3, £5,580,000 ARR across six accounts, 3 renewals within 90 days) all match the fact sheet. The date range 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-30 is plausible given cited insight dates. However, the 'another account' claim overstates the scope of affected accounts relative to the cited evidence.", "verdict": "fail"}
